eventMetadata.context_description: The Dallas Cowboys visit the New York Giants on Sunday Night Football in Week 1, pitting two NFC East rivals with overhauled coaching staffs against each other. New Giants head coach John Harbaugh brings his Ravens-honed discipline and a staff featuring offensive coordinator Matt Nagy and defensive coordinator Dennard Wilson, while Dallas operates under Brian Schottenheimer with a revamped defense. Recent roster moves include the Giants acquiring defensive tackle C.J. Okoye and positioning Odell Beckham Jr. for a potential spot, while the Cowboys face a setback with linebacker Marist Liufau sidelined weeks after fracturing his forearm in the preseason finale. Both clubs enter after 2-1 preseason marks, with Dallas holding historical edges in the series but confronting a fresh Giants scheme and home opener dynamics.
